title: SignalDefinition
description: One signal; what is measured, from which source, and how a sample of it is graded.

dimensions.description: Keys from the instance's dimension registry; an empty list declares a signal with no dimensions.

query.description: Named query texts (numerator, denominator), stored once and hashed into every sample.

cadence.description: How often the service samples the signal.

persistence.description: The hysteresis of the signal's transitions; absent means the defaults k 2, k_crit 1, m 3.

rev.description: Revision counter; 1 at proposal, one more for every revision. An evaluation names the rev it was graded against.

thalamus.definition.AdapterId.title: AdapterId
thalamus.definition.AdapterId.description: The source adapter that turns a connection operation into samples (sql, a metrics query, an orchestrator, version control, an HTTP probe, test-run events), or host, the one adapter that reads this machine's own kernel counters directly and takes no connection operation (design § 11 D46).

thalamus.definition.BaselineKind.title: BaselineKind
thalamus.definition.BaselineKind.description: A baseline a sample is graded against.

thalamus.definition.ConnectionId.title: ConnectionId
thalamus.definition.ConnectionId.description: A Connectors connection id. Thalamus holds no secret; the connection holds the credential. The id local is reserved for the host adapter, which reads only the machine thalamus runs on and refuses every other connection.

thalamus.definition.DenominatorSpec.title: DenominatorSpec
thalamus.definition.DenominatorSpec.description: The population a ratio or count is taken over.

min_n.description: Below this population the verdict is N/A.

since.description: The earliest moment the population could contain anything, as a reference (dimension.created, source retention start, first sample).

thalamus.definition.EvaluationSpec.title: EvaluationSpec
thalamus.definition.EvaluationSpec.description: How a sample is graded. The only copy of the signal's thresholds.

min_trend_window.description: For an instant signal, no delta and no trend below this window.

fixed.description: The number a fixed baseline is (a hard zero, or no history yet). A fixed baseline without it is unknown, never 0.

rolling_n.description: The N of a rolling_median baseline, the median of the last N samples of the series. Required when baselines name rolling_median.

mapping.description: A producer's own vocabulary mapped onto the ladder (a colour, a detector or gate exit code to OK, WARN, CRIT or UNKNOWN). Required, and not empty, when the rule is producer_mapped, and refused under any other rule; a producer value it does not list is UNKNOWN.

thalamus.definition.ExtractorId.title: ExtractorId
thalamus.definition.ExtractorId.description: A built-in extractor (sql.ratio) or a plugin id. The host adapter reads exactly four, host.cpu_busy, host.memory_used and host.disk_used (unit 1, disk per listed mount) and host.cpu_temperature (unit Cel), and nothing else.

thalamus.definition.History.title: History
thalamus.definition.History.description: source means the source can be re-queried at an offset; store means only thalamus remembers the series.

thalamus.definition.Links.title: Links
thalamus.definition.Links.description: What the signal is evidence about.

thalamus.definition.Persistence.title: Persistence
thalamus.definition.Persistence.description: How many evaluations must agree before a verdict change is a transition (design § 3.2, § 11 D15). Absent on a definition, the service applies k 2, k_crit 1, m 3.

k.description: Consecutive agreeing evaluations before a change of verdict settles.

k_crit.description: Consecutive agreeing evaluations before a change to CRIT settles.

m.description: Consecutive OK evaluations before a WARN clears.

thalamus.definition.QueryText.title: QueryText
thalamus.definition.QueryText.description: Query text, stored once and hashed into every sample.

thalamus.definition.SignalId.title: SignalId
thalamus.definition.SignalId.description: Stable signal id, spelled <family>.<layer>.<name> in lower case.

thalamus.definition.SignalKind.title: SignalKind
thalamus.definition.SignalKind.description: How a reading of the signal is formed. An instant signal gets no trend below its minimum trend window.

thalamus.definition.Source.title: Source
thalamus.definition.Source.description: Where a signal is read; a Connectors connection, never a credential.

thalamus.definition.Threshold.title: Threshold
thalamus.definition.Threshold.description: One line (WARN or CRIT) of a grading rule.

abs.description: Absolute floor the value must also reach.

min_events.description: Fewest events before the line applies.

thalamus.definition.Unit.title: Unit
thalamus.definition.Unit.description: A UCUM unit, case-sensitive form (1, s, By, {request}, {pod}). A ratio has unit 1.

thalamus.dimension.DimensionKey.title: DimensionKey
thalamus.dimension.DimensionKey.description: A dimension key (cluster, namespace, tenant, component, suite).

thalamus.evaluation.Verdict.title: Verdict
thalamus.evaluation.Verdict.description: The one verdict ladder. exit is the process exit code; rank orders an aggregate worst-first (CRIT > WARN > UNKNOWN > OK = N/A); scored says whether the verdict carries a score.
